title: Polyoxometalate-based all-inorganic open frameworks
claim: Co-linked {P8W48} crystals can undergo reversible crystal-to-crystal contraction and guest exchange with water, ammonia, and methanol because the ring SBU stays intact while the lattice reorganizes.
explanation: Heating W9 to 80 °C in vacuum dehydrates it and shrinks the cell from 7039.7 Å3 to 4869.7 Å3. Re-exposure to air, ammonia vapor (color change within about a minute and uptake of NH3), saturated K2SO4 solution, or methanol vapor produces additional crystalline phases. The review presents this as evidence that such all-inorganic frameworks are chemoresponsive toward NH3, H2O, and methanol.
scope: Co-bridged {P8W48} framework W9 and its dehydrated, rehydrated, ammonia, and methanol phases.
conditions: 80 °C under vacuum for dehydration; air for partial rehydration; ammonia vapor about 1 min; methanol vapor 30 min; saturated K2SO4 for two weeks for one rehydrated phase.
caveats: Multiple single-crystal routes are documented for this one framework family; the review does not show the same guest set for every {P8W48} phase.
